title: RareNation
description: Hardcore SMP where you gain lives by killing players and lose them on death. PvP, raiding, and survival focus
body: RareNationSMP is a hardcore survival server with PvP, raiding, alliances, and base building. Every death removes a life, but killing players gives lives back. Lose all your lives and you get banned for 1 hour before resetting. Fight smart, protect your base, and survive.
